dict.string: Wockett reads your step count from Apple Health to track your daily walking goal.
Wockett saves your walks and rides to Apple Health, including distance, duration, active calories, and GPS route, so your activity contributes to your Move and Exercise rings.
Wockett continues tracking your walk when the screen is off so your route and distance stay accurate.

Wockett uses your location to suggest nearby walking routes, track your position during in-app navigation, and calculate distances. Route coordinates are sent to a free elevation service (opentopodata.org) to display elevation profiles.
Wockett counts your steps during walks using the device motion sensor, giving you an accurate step count alongside GPS distance tracking.
Wockett can add recurring walk reminders to your calendar so you never miss a walk.
